# The OLT side of one provisioning session of a six-upstream-flow line (ISP3),
# from cold boot to the last service: one baseline OMCI frame per line, for
# src/omci/drv-test.sh and vlan-test.sh. Three T-CONTs (0x8000 one GEM, 0x8001
# one, 0x8002 four), six data GEMs, one 802.1p mapper and one VLAN filter per
# GEM (VIDs 10, 20, 30+32, 40, 50, 60), and an extended-VLAN rule set on the
# UNI that adds VLAN 30 to untagged frames. Its store
# (omci-store-isp3.xml) is the factory one: manual VLAN 30, priority 255.
# Rebuilt from the omcid log of that session by
# src/omci/tools/session-from-log.py: the log keeps the first 16 bytes of
# each message contents (20 for a GemPortCtp create), so the rest are zero
# unless restored below, and a get carries the mask of its answer. CRC zero.
# Restored (the "# restored" lines below, offsets in the contents), all from a
# MIB readback of the same line:
#   t..@16      the last two bytes of each extended-VLAN rule: the treatment
#               inner VID (and TPID 0), 4096 for the discard defaults;
#   84/4@24     class 84 creates: FwdOp 0x10, one entry (the list itself is in
#               the first bytes); t..@24/26: the two-entry list's count;
#   130/4@16, t..@16  the eighth p-bit pointer of each mapper.
# Scrubbed: nothing to withhold (no credential, address or identity: OltG
# contents are zeroed by the tool, the rest holds no text).
# Regenerated only from a session log; a frame is not edited by hand.
# restored: t39773@16=8000 (1 message)
# restored: t39774@16=8000 (1 message)
# restored: t39779@16=8000 (1 message)
# restored: t39780@16=8000 (1 message)
# restored: 130/4@16=ffff (6 messages)
# restored: 84/4@24=1001 (6 messages)
# restored: t39804@16=0001 (1 message)
# restored: t39813@16=0002 (1 message)
# restored: t39820@24=1002 (1 message)
# restored: t39822@16=0003 (1 message)
# restored: t39823@26=02 (1 message)
# restored: t39831@16=0004 (1 message)
# restored: t39839@16=0005 (1 message)
# restored: t39862@16=0006 (1 message)
# restored: t39863@16=00f0 (1 message)
# restored: t39864@16=0100 (1 message)
# restored: t39865@16=01e0 (1 message)
# restored: t39866@16=0050 (1 message)
# restored: t39868@16=00f4 (1 message)
